# **Variable List**

```{r Codebook-Chunk, include = FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)







# Grab sample size (Probably need something to deal with weird ID names, fix later)
n <- length(unique(thisData$Participant.ID))




out2 <- ""

# Grab item list
items <- unique(blockMap$Item.ID)


# For each item in item list, make block and knit
for(item in items) {
  itemBlock <- blockMap[(blockMap$Item.ID == item & !is.na(blockMap$Item.ID)), ]
  thisBlock <- itemBlock[1,]
  
  if(thisBlock$Item.Type == "Question") {
    attach(thisBlock)
    question_type <- thisBlock$Question.Type.Display.Name
    question_type_no_space <- gsub(" ", "", question_type)
    
    # Grab chunk labels
      chunk_label <- paste(thisBlock$Question.Type.Display.Name, thisBlock$Question.ID, item)
      chunk_label <- gsub(" ", "-", chunk_label)
      # Fail safe to clean any special characters that sneak in
      chunk_label <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9\\-]", "", chunk_label)
    
    
    out2 <- paste( 
      out2,
      knit_expand(
        file = paste0("DataTypes/", question_type_no_space, ".Rmd"),
        question_text = thisBlock$Question.Text,
        item_id = thisBlock$Item.ID,
        question_type = thisBlock$Question.Type.Display.Name,
        result_type = thisBlock$Result.Type,
        question_id = thisBlock$Question.ID,
        chunk_label = chunk_label,
        itemBlock = itemBlock,
        n = n
      )
    )
    detach(thisBlock)
  }
}


```

`r knit(text=out2)`
